P48-1.label: FLAT_MATERIAL
P48-1.board_formula: board_t = reference_median for every non-anchor current type t
P48-1.hand_formula: hand_t = reference_median * EvaluationConfig.hand_weight for every corresponding non-anchor base type t
P48-1.anchor_formula: anchor board and hand channels are excluded and zero
P48-1.quantization: preserve float values in checkpoint; native integer quantization uses existing checkpoint/native path only

P48-2.label: DETERMINISTIC_PERTURBED
P48-2.grouping: group non-anchor types by equal P48-0 board value
P48-2.distinct_value_order: distinct positive P48-0 board values in numeric ascending order
P48-2.equal_value_group_rule: all types in an equal-value group receive the same factor
P48-2.channels: multiply corresponding board and hand channels by the same factor
P48-2.rescaling: one common scalar over all resulting board and hand values so non-anchor board median equals the original P48-0 reference_median
P48-2.clipping: none; existing checkpoint validity limit is fail-closed rejection

P48-3.label: CYCLIC_PERMUTED
P48-3.ordering_definition: lexicographically sorted tuple returned by the helper
P48-3.permutation: for ordered types (t0,...,t(n-1)), new_weight(t_i) = old_weight(t_(i+1 mod n))
P48-3.board_channel: apply the source-to-destination permutation to board weights
P48-3.hand_channel: apply the same source-to-destination permutation to corresponding hand weights
P48-3.n_less_than_two: return an exact copy with no permutation

material_vector.dimension: 2*n where n is the number of non-anchor types
material_vector.distance: Euclidean L2 over concatenated board+hand coordinates

search_aware_training_positions.generator: existing generic_chess.learning.openings.generate_arena_openings using GameSession legal actions and canonical action ordering
search_aware_training_positions.collision_policy: abort before learning on any identity collision
search_aware_training_positions.training_target: M48-1 objective positions only; never holdout positions

teacher_holdout.generator: existing generic_chess.learning.openings.generate_arena_openings using GameSession legal actions and canonical action ordering
teacher_holdout.collision_policy: abort before learning on any identity collision
teacher_holdout.learner_access: evaluation only after candidate ranking; never an optimization objective

paired_arena_openings.collision_policy: abort before learning on any identity collision

M48-1.direction_normalization: each raw direction is divided by its Euclidean L2 norm; zero norm rejects the protocol

direction_families.alternating_sign: raw d_j = 1 when j is even, -1 when j is odd
direction_families.first_half_positive: raw d_j = 1 for j < ceil(D/2), otherwise -1
direction_families.board_hand_differential: raw d_j = 1 for board coordinates and -1 for hand coordinates
direction_families.seeded_normalized_pseudorandom: Python CPython random.Random(Mersenne Twister) seeded 480703; draw D values by uniform(-1.0,1.0) in coordinate order

M48-1.reference_norm: L2 norm of concatenated P48-0 board+hand vector
M48-1.mutation_formula: child_vector = parent_vector + sign * mutation_l2_fraction_of_reference * reference_norm * normalized_direction
M48-1.sign_schedule: sign = +1 when (optimizer_generation + offspring_index) is even, otherwise -1
M48-1.positive_weight_policy: reject any nonfinite or nonpositive non-anchor board/hand coordinate before normalization
M48-1.median_rescaling: after mutation, rescale one common scalar so non-anchor board median equals P48-0 reference_median; reject if median is nonpositive or nonfinite
M48-1.validity_limit: call existing checkpoint ensure_within_limits; reject rather than clip on violation
M48-1.elite_survival: the two selected elite checkpoint objects survive unchanged into the next optimizer generation
M48-1.offspring_template: offspring k uses elite k mod 2, direction family k mod 4, and the sign schedule above for k=0..5
M48-1.duplicate_candidate_policy: retain the first candidate in deterministic template order and omit later duplicates; do not refill; fail closed if fewer than elite_count valid candidates remain
M48-1.candidate_ranking: higher exact training-position teacher agreement, then smaller concatenated board+hand L2 displacement from that generation's parent, then canonical checkpoint hash ascending
M48-1.failed_search_policy: abort candidate scoring; never convert failure to disagreement or draw
M48-1.checkpoint_parent: the parent checkpoint used by the offspring template

material_leverage_prerequisite.perturbation: each non-anchor type's board and corresponding hand channels jointly multiplied by 0.75 and 1.25; all other channels fixed
material_leverage_prerequisite.zero_channel_policy: skip zero-valued channels and report them explicitly
material_leverage_prerequisite.metric: mean valid best-move flip rate across all valid single-type perturbations
material_leverage_prerequisite.failed_search_policy: fail closed and mark leverage prerequisite invalid

teacher_stability_prerequisite.metric: exact best-move agreement between primary teacher and stability reference

generated_benchmark_eligibility.shallow_deep_agreement: 500-node versus 4000-node exact best-move agreement in [0.30,0.98] inclusive
generated_benchmark_eligibility.selection_inputs: structural, terminal, search-sensitivity, and Gen0 artificial-perturbation metrics only

arena_qualification.catastrophic_regression_threshold: paired mean score < 0.25 against corresponding starting checkpoint
arena_qualification.strength_improvement: paired mean score > 0.5 and bootstrap lower bound > 0.5
arena_qualification.confidence_method: existing paired-score bootstrap with frozen seed and interval procedure
arena_qualification.starting_checkpoint_pairing: compare each trained checkpoint against its own P48 starting checkpoint

parameter_ownership.parameter_family: rule semantics, legality, terminal and repetition semantics
board and hand material checkpoint weights
dynamic mobility, promotion-potential, and anchor-safety coefficients

classification_precedence.condition: remove RuleSets with material leverage < 0.05 or teacher self-agreement < 0.85; retain the limiting invalidity label
classification_precedence.resolution: if leverage is limiting use MATERIAL_ONLY_LEVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT; if teacher stability is limiting use SEARCH_ENGINE_LIMITS_LEARNING; if both limit use MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED

classification_precedence.condition: fewer than two admissible primary RuleSets remain
classification_precedence.resolution: use the limiting invalidity label from priority 1; do not judge learner recovery

classification_precedence.condition: for one learner and one admissible RuleSet, at least two of P48-1/P48-2/P48-3 recover and none is catastrophic
classification_precedence.resolution: count that RuleSet as recovered for that learner

classification_precedence.condition: a learner recovers at least two admissible primary RuleSets but no learner demonstrates supported P48-0 beyond-prior improvement
P48-0 beyond-prior improvement is supported and M48-0 recovers at least two primary RuleSets
P48-0 beyond-prior improvement is supported and M48-1 recovers at least two primary RuleSets
all admissible prerequisites pass and neither learner recovers two primary RuleSets
none of the preceding exact conditions applies

recovery_aggregation.per_ruleset: learner counts as recovered on a RuleSet iff at least two of the three disturbed priors recover and none has catastrophic regression
recovery_aggregation.generic_recovery: learner counts as generic only when at least two primary RuleSets count as recovered
recovery_aggregation.beyond_prior_improvement: P48-0-trained checkpoint holdout teacher agreement improves by >= 0.02 absolute, paired arena mean > 0.5, bootstrap lower bound > 0.5, and no architecture/search-integrity gate fails
